what_to_bring: Most recent detailed clinical progress note from the treating physician

A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating hepatologist (liver specialist) or gastroenterologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It must include a detailed summary of the history of the condition; current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any); physical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment; plan (prognosis); and follow-up.
If there is ANY history of hepatic encephalopathy, ascites or varices.

rows.label: B
rows.evaluation_data: Submit the following for FAA review: - 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating hepatologist (liver specialist) or gastroenterologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It must include a detailed summary of the history of the condition; current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any); physical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment; plan (prognosis); and follow-up. - 2. It must specifically include: - How the condition was diagnosed, etiology, hospitalizations, - If there is ANY history of hepatic encephalopathy, ascites or varices. - Calculation of Child-Pugh score - 3. Lab: Performed within 90 days of exam to include: - CBC; - Comprehensive metabolic panel; - GGT; - Alpha-fetoprotein; and - PT/PTT/INR
rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

  • 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating hepatologist (liver specialist) or gastroenterologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It must include a detailed summary of the history of the condition; current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any); physical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment; plan (prognosis); and follow-up.
  • 2. It must specifically include:
    • How the condition was diagnosed, etiology, hospitalizations,
    • If there is ANY history of hepatic encephalopathy, ascites or varices.
    • Calculation of Child-Pugh score
  • 3. Lab: Performed within 90 days of exam to include:
    • CBC;
    • Comprehensive metabolic panel;
    • GGT;
    • Alpha-fetoprotein; and
    • PT/PTT/INR
